text: Tesla achieved record production, deliveries and surpassed $1 billion in non-GAAP net income for the first time.
We achieved record production, deliveries, and surpassed over $1 billion in GAAP net income for the first time in Tesla's history.
Lastly, thanks to $5.5 billion of GAAP net income in 2021, our accumulated profitability since the inception of the Company became positive, which I think makes us a real company at this point.
While doing so, we generated $12.5 billion in net income and $7.5 billion in free cash flow.
